# Dust Disturbance and Mitigation Awareness Training

> 1-hour online awareness course for construction and industrial workers on recognizing, controlling and preventing harmful dust exposure, aligned with OSHA construction (29 CFR 1926), general industry (29 CFR 1910) and HAZWOPER standards. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 1 hour; 5 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.1 CEU
- Price: $47.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, mobile-friendly; virtual instructor-led and in-person formats also available
- Language: English
- Prerequisites: none
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 3 years

## Lessons
1. Dust
2. Dust and Health (silica, asbestos, nuisance dust)
3. Brownfields
4. Dust Control (engineering controls, wet cutting, ventilation, respiratory protection)
5. Dust Monitoring (permissible exposure limits, monitoring obligations, hazard assessments)

## Who should take it
Construction laborers and contractors; demolition, masonry, stone, cement and paving crews; heavy equipment operators; miners, rock drillers and jackhammer operators; renovation workers; remediation and abatement teams; quarry, foundry and manufacturing workers; supervisors and safety managers; anyone working around asbestos-containing materials or naturally occurring asbestos.
